# Locked-import dependency fixture

Locked npm package: `preact@10.29.8` (pinned by `package.json`'s `^10.29.8` range;
the exact resolved version is recorded in `deno.lock`). `scripts/main.ts` imports
the `preact/hooks` subpath and uses its `useState` export, exercising the
subpath-matching path of the build's lock gate.

`package.json` and `deno.lock` were generated by `wda deps add preact` and
committed as-is; `preact` is small, pure JavaScript, ships bundled type
declarations, has no lifecycle scripts, and exposes `preact/hooks` as a
subpath export.
